ph: Honored with a popcorn garland on his birthday celebration. 7 Dec 99

w: Swamishri was stricken with fever on the previous night. Today he rested, met devotees, held a couple of meetings and answered letters. Swamishri recovered a few days later.

Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals (vastu-yagna) of the mandir complex. At 10:30 am, Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of the panchdhatu murti of Nilkanth Varni in the rang mandap of the mandir. During his blessings Swamishri spoke about the glory of Nilkanth Varni's 7-year travels. "Shriji Maharaj traveled to all the pilgrim places, then came to Gujarat and to the shores of the river Narmada. This land has been sanctified by the holy feet of Shriji Maharaj. This mandir has been created through His wish, and the wish of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj and the efforts of devotees and sadhus. Whoever will come for darshan will experience peace in his heart… we have installed this murti (of Nilkanth Varni) here to remind us that Maharaj had come here during His seven-year sojourn, and to fulfil the dreams and wishes of thousands who will come here for darshan… "

In the evening assembly, Swamishri's 81st birthday celebration was held (according to English Calendar). Speeches and dramas showed Swamishri's work of elevating humanity. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

The venue of the 30-acre celebration site, was thrown open to devotees and well-wishers. The decorative main stage and the performing stage was flanked by two giant video screens. The 82nd birthday celebration of Swamishri commenced at 5.30 p.m. Thereafter, Pujya Dr. Swami spoke on the glory of a Gunatit Sadhu and the means to please him and earn his grace. Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami discoursed on the subject 'Sant - the means to resolve problems' with incidents about how Swamishri resolves crisis and problems in the lives of people. Some universal problems plaguing our society were posed to Swamishri. With his vast experience in resolving problems, his selflessness and his rapport with God, Swamishri replied to 5 important questions. Prior to each question a short video was shown about his contribution in that field of service. Prior to the question-answer programme, a colourful and impressive welcome dance was performed by BAPS children and teenagers.
Balaks of Kolkata mandal recited ‘Shanti-path' and shloks during Swamishri's morning walk.

At 6.00 p.m., the special evening assembly commenced with Shanti-path. Two balaks presented a speech in Hindi about an ideal child and effect of company. Thereafter balaks and kishores of Kolkata mandal performed “Sant Param Hitkari…” Then a classical dance presentation by Odissi youths stunned the audience. The kishores of Kolkata mandal performed a folkdance. Finally, Swamishri addressed the assembly underscoring the glory of human birth and the need to attaining values and moksha.
ph: Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 83rd Janma Jayanti Celebration, Mimai, FL

w: Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji on the occasion of Anand mandir’s seventh consecration anniversary (patostav). In the evening Swamishri performed arti of Thakorji at Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay, Vidyanagar, on the occasion of its consecration anniversary (patotsav). This was followed by a celebration of Swamishri’s birthday according to the English date at Akshar Farm. Viveksagar Swami discoursed on Swamishri’s saintliness. BAPS children and youth performed a traditional dance. Thereafter senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Today we have celebrated the patotsav. Whatever bhakti we do for God is divine, because God is divine. There is not an iota of maya in him. His speech, walking, travelling, or whatever he does is divine. He is the form of bliss. Doing his darshan, listening to his talks, sitting besides him gives happiness. He is the abode of happiness. Such is his glory. It is because of him that we are celebrating today. Whatever we do for him will become our means to reach his abode. So celebrate such festivals, engage oneself in his darshan and listen to spiritual discourses. This will give peace within.” Finally all the devotees performed arti and dispersed after having mahaprasad.
ph: ... engaged in darshan of Shastriji Maharaj

w: According to the English calendar the day marked Swamishri’s 88th birthday. After Thakorji’s darshan he performed abhishek of Nilkanth Varni. Thereafter Swamishri performed his morning puja. The senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri. A souvenir ‘Satpurush’, prepared by sadhus and youths of Mumbai for Swamishri’s 88th Birthday Celebration, was inaugurated by Dr Swami. In the evening Swamishri attended the Sunday satsang assembly. After Viveksagar Swami’s discourse Swamishri was honoured with garlands. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the mammoth gathering, “One may acquire things of this world, but the darshan of God, discourses about God, an association of a true sadhu are rare. When one gets the association and refuge of a bona fide sadhu one’s life becomes full of joy and inner satisfaction.”

According to the English calendar today marked Swamishri’s 89th birthday and his entry into his 90th year. Youths and devotees had decorated the pathway and walls outside his room with greetings, balloons and candles. They greeted Swamishri on his arrival by singing “ Abhinandan, abhinandan,… ”

After the puja, as his daily routine, Pramukh Swami Maharaj joins his hands to everyone and says "Jai Swaminarayan". The joining of hands always begins from the left side. Today Kothari Swami was sitting on a chair on that side. However, as a kirtan was going on, his gaze was on the sadhu singing the kirtan. Swamishri was joining his hands and saying "Jai Swaminarayan", but he did not notice, so Swamishri kept his hands joined until his eyes fell on him. When the seated sadhus pointed this out to Kothari Swami, he at once looked at Swamishri, and Swamishri bowed his head and said "Jai Swaminarayan", and then said "Jai Swaminarayan" in all directions. What great regard Swamishri has for senior sadhus!!!

ds.t: May the whole world be well
w: The golden jubilee celebration of satsang is going on in Kampala, Uganda. For this, besides senior sadhus of the organisation, 40 sadhus and many devotees have gone there. When this was mentioned, a sadhu said, "Just today Harishbhai Bhuptani phoned from Kampala and said that there is a festive atmosphere there. A thousand devotees eat every day."
Hearing this, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Wah! A thousand devotees!"
In the course of talk, Indian youths going to America were discussed, and Shrihari Swami said, "Right now it is not worth going to America at all. The recession in America is very terrible."
As soon as he heard such talk of recession, Swamishri said, "We pray that all may be well. May America be well and may the world be well too."

Today, on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday, Mahant Swami Maharaj was seated in the car going towards "Swaminarayan Nagar" for his morning puja. At that time the sadhus asked him, "What thoughts came to you this morning?"

"Just one thought: pure divinity. Pramukh Swami Maharaj is present. Otherwise this would not be possible. A united atmosphere. A feeling of helping one another. In the hearts of all the donors who have done this seva, Bapa is seated; otherwise this would not happen at all."
Today everyone understood especially that Swamishri's mind remains lost in his guru not just today but always.

Today Shri Amitbhai Shah (National President, BJP) and Shri Vijaybhai Rupani (Chief Minister) were to come for the main assembly of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday celebration. A personal meeting with Mahant Swami Maharaj had been arranged with them before they went to the assembly. For this Swamishri came to the room for meeting dignitaries. Seated here, he was waiting for the guests. Harikrishna Maharaj had been seated right in front of him. All the sadhus with him were engaged in their own duties. At that time Swamishri closed his eyes, took his mala in his hand and began chanting the mahamantra "Swaminarayan".

On one side the assembly hall, packed with a crowd of thousands of devotees, was resounding; on the other, the moments until national level leaders arrived were being counted. At that time Swamishri was absorbed in the worship of God! This is the solitude of the ekantik.

ds.t: Blessings on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday
w: Today, giving blessings in the assembly for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday celebration, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"This 'Swaminarayan Nagar' has been created only through the inspiration of Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Many people have drawn inspiration from the mandir and exhibitions created in it, looked within, and learnt lessons of morality. All this is divine and grand; there is no doubt about it. I experience divinity in every particle here. Such a divine work is Swamibapa's.

"In Pramukh Swami Maharaj's heart there was nothing but God. In every pore of his body you would find nothing but Shriji Maharaj. Within each one of his virtues many other virtues are contained. The extraordinary, divine virtues in him cannot be described. These are the virtues of God himself. Imbibing the virtues of God includes everything. He was the very embodiment of virtues. Because of this, these thousands of volunteers and sadhus have been formed. Swamibapa studied only up to the sixth standard, but what a great amount of work he did! The reason was a pure heart. Pramukh Swami Maharaj did not remain limited to the Sampraday; he has pervaded the whole world. All virtues were inborn in him. Shastriji Maharaj had said, 'Our work will continue.' It will truly continue. So in this way God is manifest.

"Swamibapa used to say, 'In the joy of others lies our joy, in the good of others lies our good.' This is the essence of all the scriptures. Swamibapa did not merely say this; he lived it every moment, night and day. He worked with this very feeling.

"In this festival we have seen here a completely united atmosphere. A feeling of helping one another. Even in difficulties, everyone has worked with a smile. In this way Pramukh Swami Maharaj worked so that there is peace in the world, in the country, in society and in families."

In the evening, in the discussion for the Swamini Vato app, with reference to talk 6/251, the sadhus asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "When he garlands someone or praises someone, that pleasure is not false... is it?"

Swamishri: "It is to take that person forward. We want to grant moksha. We want to take him from the second book to the fifth book. All the pleasure is useful. The levels are different. One is standing at the number 10 and another is standing at 25. When one goes from 10 to 25, the pleasure looks the same, but the pleasure for one at 10 and one at 50 is different. The pleasure is not false, it is not pretence, it is truly genuine. But according to one's level, one gets the fruit of that pleasure."
Question: "Premanand Swami composed kirtans and said to Maharaj, 'May this murti remain constantly in my heart.' Then Maharaj said, 'The means for that are different!' So what are those means?"

Swamishri: "Being atmarup (identified with the atma). It begins from there. All the other means are of body consciousness, they do not last long. If one behaves as the atma, one does not fall back. One goes on progressing further and further. There is a great difference between identifying with the body and identifying with the atma. The other one (with body consciousness) may look any way; we all may feel that the guru is very pleased with him. And if someone is behaving as the atma, it does not show..."
Question: "If pleasure begins by understanding oneself as the atma, then where does the pleasure stop after that?"
Swamishri: "The same means are to be practised, but only as the atma!"
Question: "Even if you do not show your pleasure, how can we know that you are pleased?"
Swamishri: "You will experience it. Distinctly, that Swami is right with me. He is with me."
Question: "Even after realisation, there should still be a pull towards the manifest form, isn't that right?!"
Swamishri: "It happens if the manifest and the unmanifest are believed to be one. If there is even a slight difference, the pull does not remain."
The sadhus present felt that today the same Gunatitanand Swami was again giving greater depth to the talks he himself had given.

st.t: ‘Spirituality can, indeed, lead us to rise above’: California State Assembly delegation visits Swaminarayan Akshardham

Six members of the California State Assembly visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on the birthday anniversary of Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Pramukh Swami Maharaj, creator of Akshardham, was the fifth spiritual successor of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and led the BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS) for 45 years.
The delegation was greeted in a traditional manner by senior sadhus and volunteers of BAPS on behalf of Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj, the current spiritual leader of BAPS.
The sixteen-member delegation was led by California State Assemblymember Ash Kalra (San Jose), an Indian-American who in 2017 met with Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj in San Jose.

The group also included Assemblymember Cecilia Aguiar-Curry (Winters), Assemblymember Richard Bloom (Santa Monica) Assemblymember Member Sharon Quirk-Silva (Fullerton), Assemblymember Eloise Gomez Reyes (San Bernardino) and Assemblymember Mark Stone (Monterey Bay).

“The Mandir complex is truly representative of a modern-day wonder of the world and the six Assemblymembers who made up the first-ever California delegation to the site learned a tremendous amount about Indian spirituality and history as part of their visit,” said Assemblymember Kalra. “I look forward to returning and believe this is a must-see for all foreign delegations.”
Assemblymember Quirk-Silva agreed with Assemblymember Kalra’s sentiments: “I feel like a whole new person [with] a depth of knowledge and a focus on elevating those around me.”
“I appreciate your devotion,” added Assemblymember Aguiar-Curry.

During their visit, the Delegation offered their respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and performed abhishek, the ceremonial pouring of sanctified water from 151 holy rivers, lakes and ponds across India on the sacred image of Shri Neelkanth Varni. The delegation toured the educational exhibitions Sahajanand Darshan (Hall of Values) – a series of animatronics shows depicting the ideals of nonviolence, honest, harmony and faith, and Sanskruti Vihar – a cultural voyage that sails through 10,000 years of India’s heritage and contributions to society.

“It is a true honor to be welcomed to your traditions and learn of the tenets of your faith. If the world as it currently is will reflect on the enlightenment presented here, it will, indeed, be a more peaceful place,” said Assemblymember Stone.

“Thank you for the absolute privilege of showing us and teaching us about a beautiful way of life,” added Assemblymember Gomez Reyes. “Like the peacock, I will strive to walk tall and proud but with my head down in humility. Like the elephants, I will strive to keep my family together and strong.”

The delegation also learned about the life work of Pramukh Swami Maharaj on a day that marked the 98th anniversary of his birth. His common adage, “In the joy of others, lies our own,” resonated with the delegation’s goal of public service.
“Spirituality can, indeed, lead us to rise above,” said Assemblymember Bloom.

California is home to one of only six BAPS shikarbaddh mandirs in North America and more than ten mandirs and centers throughout the state. Pramukh Swami Maharaj first visited the state in the late 1970s, and opened California’s first BAPS center in 1984. Since then, BAPS in California has flourished and plays an active role in serving its community. Most recently, BAPS Charities is working with local officials to help offset the effects of the ravaging wildfires in the northern and southern parts of the state.
